title: A pure timing plan for the transcode command
description: Command mixes timing, probing and arguments, so the seam arithmetic that every segment relies on is tested only through ffmpeg runs.
acceptanceCriteria: A function with no I/O takes the source's start, frame duration, keyframe, audio grid and segment, and returns the video seek, audio seek and drop filter
Table tests reproduce the values the seam tests rely on, for a source starting at 0, at a positive start and at a negative one
Command takes an encoder description, and the seam integration tests pass unchanged
